title: How to create a new Demo & Trial Business Central tenant via Microsoft Demo eXperiences (MDX) – formerly CDX
summary: Creating a trial Business Central tenant via Microsoft Demo eXperiences (MDX), the successor to Customer Digital Experiences (CDX), requires navigating through Experiences and claiming a new tenant since the direct Create Tenant page has been deprecated.
key_points: MDX replaces CDX for creating trial Business Central environments with an updated process
Trial tenants are claimed through the Experiences section by selecting an experience and choosing 'Claim new tenant'
Only one trial tenant can be created at a time, with a 90-day duration, and only 3 environments can be created per month
Partners can access and manage created tenants through the MDX Dashboard

quotes.text: Customer Digital Experiences (CDX) has recently been officially updated to Microsoft Demo eXperiences (MDX). The method for creating a trial version has changed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates a platform transition that partners need to be aware of for creating test environments

quotes.text: You can only create one trial tenant (90 day).
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets clear expectations about trial environment limitations

quotes.text: Only 3 environments can be created per month.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes rate limits that partners must plan around
